WITH copd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON co.condition_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 255573
), bronchodilator_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id, concept_name,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%albuterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%salbutamol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%levalbuterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%salmeterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%formoterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%arformoterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%vilanterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%indacaterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%olodaterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%metaproterenol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pirbuterol%' THEN 'Adrenergic beta2-Agonists'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ipratropium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tiotropium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%aclidinium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%umeclidinium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%glycopyrrolate%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%glycopyrronium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%revefenacin%' THEN 'Cholinergic Antagonists'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%theophylline%' THEN 'Xanthines'
      WHEN LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%roflumilast%' THEN 'Phosphodiesterase 4 Inhibitors'
    END AS mechanism
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE domain_id = 'Drug'
    AND (
      LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%albuterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%salbutamol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%levalbuterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%salmeterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%formoterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%arformoterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%vilanterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%indacaterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%olodaterol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%metaproterenol%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%pirbuterol%' OR
      LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%ipratropium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%tiotropium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%aclidinium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%umeclidinium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%glycopyrrolate%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%glycopyrronium%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%revefenacin%' OR
      LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%theophylline%' OR LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%roflumilast%'
    )
), active_rx AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_id, bc.mechanism, bc.concept_name
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN copd ON copd.person_id = de.person_id
  JOIN bronchodilator_concepts bc ON bc.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date <= CAST('2026-07-23' AS date)
    AND COALESCE(de.drug_exposure_end_date, DATEADD(day, COALESCE(de.days_supply, 0), de.drug_exposure_start_date), de.drug_exposure_start_date) >= CAST('2026-07-23' AS date)
)
SELECT mechanism,
       COUNT(*) AS active_prescriptions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patients_with_active_rx,
       COUNT(DISTINCT concept_name) AS distinct_drug_concepts
FROM active_rx
GROUP BY mechanism
ORDER BY patients_with_active_rx DESC, active_prescriptions DESC;
